Order
This is third application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 17/10/2022 in connection with Crime No.499/2022,
registered at Police Station Mauganj, District Rewa for the offence punishable under Sections 366,
376(D), 368, 344, 506, 201, 376(2)(n), 365 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since last two years.
He has falsely been implicated in case.
It is submitted that there is anomaly in statements recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. and under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
It is also submitted that DNA report is negative.
In change circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Government Advocate for the State has opposed the prayer and submitted that gang rape is committed by applicant.
Offence is heinous in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45912 2 MCRC-38633-2024 nature.
In these circumstances he may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Taking into account the fact that DNA report is negative, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
